People reacted angrily back then when I dared to predict what in fact
turned out to be true when the FBI arrested a Harvard mathematician,
and now I get the same antagonism from the likes of Patrick Juola
with respect to my predictions of how we will accomplish AI and MT.

http://www.geocities.com/Athens/Agora/7256/mind-fpc.html Mind.Forth
has some math problems in it, and I call upon all the David Hilberts
and Henri Mersennes of our day to help in finding the proper values
to plug into the SPREADACT routine where the AI associates concepts.

Finally, before I yield the floor to the "kitten" from Colorado,
please observe the results of my wining and dining a Japanoise
who aided and abetted me in translating a Mentifex mind-diagram.

Her face flushed with pleasure when I confided, "By the way,
your code name in my diaries is Dakota," and she still calls
herself "Dakota" in her e-mails from Tokyo.  (She looks like
Yoko Ono, who with John Lennon lived in the Dakota Apartments.
They all get code names, like "Bionica" or "Odna Mona.")

Now, Alex, a lot of the hits on the Mind.Forth Web site have
been coming from Japan.  Maybe the Japanese see some value in:

no = [possessive particle] "of"

Togo = arrangement of words
Zo = image(s)
